name: New Albany campus
status_note: $3.5B AWS project (tax deal approved Sep 2023); eastern and middle buildings operational (Epoch counts ~213 MW IT, the AI share only), northern buildings due 2027 (~338 MW).

announced.note: New Albany city council approves tax break for $3.5B Amazon data center project, 20 Sep 2023.

construction_start.note: Epoch satellite: land clearing for Buildings 5–9 begins 1 Jun 2022.

operational.note: Buildings 5–9 partly occupied per New Albany's Dec 2024 report.

sources.title: AWS New Albany – AI data center directory
New Albany city council approves tax break deal for $3.5 billion Amazon data center project

review_notes: Epoch counts only ~44% of campus IT power (the AI-chip share), so the full campus is larger. Construction began before the dated announcement. Coordinates offset from Meta Prometheus for display; refine.
